dedupe_keys.name: transience open database of policies and technologies for industrial circularity and decarbonisation steel cement and concrete plastics

description: This database lists circular economy and decarbonisation interventions for steel, cement and concrete and plastics, built in the Horizon Europe project TRANSIENCE to feed MIC3, an open-source model ecosystem for industrial circularity, decarbonisation and sustainability. The Zenodo record says interventions are classified by the 9R framework (refuse, rethink, reduce, reuse, repair, refurbish, remanufacture, repurpose, recycle) and by narrowing, slowing, substituting and closing resource loops, and that it includes technologies and their costs that cut emissions through circularity. It was published on 25 April 2025 by Teresa Domenech Aparisi, Alvaro Calzadilla Rivera, Zijie Ma and Haoning Liu of University College London as one downloadable Excel file of about 1.7 MB, free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is the three sectors, with a European focus. Caveats: the number of entries and the cost sources are not stated in the part of the record read. For simulation it gives options and costs for circular strategies to test how industry could reduce raw material and energy demand in transition scenarios. Related catalogue records include the EU-China BRIDGE industrial policy inventories and the Mopo Industry Technology Catalogue.
